# @three-ws/signals-mcp

> Discover, subscribe to, and track three.ws copy-trade signal feeds from any AI agent — a marketplace ranked by proven realized edge, a publisher leaderboard from real on-chain performance, and account-scoped subscribe + kill-switch controls over the live API.

@three-ws/signals-mcp is a Model Context Protocol server from three.ws. Install: `npx -y @three-ws/signals-mcp`.

## Docs

- [README](https://github.com/nirholas/crypto-signals-mcp/blob/main/README.md): install, configuration, full reference
- [Documentation site](https://nirholas.github.io/crypto-signals-mcp/): the README as a web page
- [Full text for LLMs](https://nirholas.github.io/crypto-signals-mcp/llms-full.txt): README inlined
- [AGENTS.md](https://github.com/nirholas/crypto-signals-mcp/blob/main/AGENTS.md): guidance for coding agents
